description: Verify an OpenTimestamps proof (.ots as base64, from btc-timestamp or any ots client): upgrades pending proofs from the calendars, checks each Bitcoin attestation against the real block's merkle root and returns status (confirmed, pending), block height and time, the upgraded proof, and whether your text, hash or URL matches. Price: $0.003 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"ots_base64":"","text":"Hello World!\n"}.
